findings.text: A New Conversation prepare while the Mac has another conversation open answers applied without preparing; the send then prepares and waits for readiness. Matches docs and fixture.
Never reset; a ComposeBar reused across conversations would inherit it. Cosmetic.
.stopped counts as passing, so an engaged bar in a long background stop shows a quiet Connecting… with Send off.
The silent half of the PrepareWait test leaves its perform waiting up to the 90 s command timeout. Harmless.
No test of a prepare replaced behind another conversation's prepare, or of ledger replay of a replaced command; recording is consistent.
The engaged gate is view-only state with no unit test; covered by the live check.
